The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all six sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex K polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between 12-vertex and 9-vertex coordination polyhedra.
